title_en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Amiibo Reveal Includes Young Link and Young Zelda Figures
summary_en: Nintendo has revealed Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo for its The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
body_en:
Nintendo has revealed Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo for its The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
Both toys-to-life collectibles are expected to launch sometime in 2027, meaning it will be at least a few months after the game itself actually launches for Nintendo Switch 2 come November 5, 2026. Young Link and Young Zelda will unlock special in-game masks based on the original Nintendo 64 Ocarina of Time that released in 1998.
It’s not exactly a surprise to see Nintendo’s new remake get two amiibo of its own, but it’s certainly still the kind of thing fans will want to keep an eye out for in the months ahead. While we wait to see everything they’ll be able to add to the experience, you can see new screenshots below.
For everything else announced during The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, you can click right here .
